enrichments.summary: Artisan Multigrain Bread is being recalled because its label does not clearly declare the egg allergen, despite egg whites being an ingredient. This poses a risk to individuals with egg allergies.
key_regulations: Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA)

enrichments.summary: Gluten-free seasoned bread crumbs are being recalled because their labels failed to clearly declare the allergens Egg and Milk due to printing quality issues. The product is packaged in vacuum-sealed clear plastic, 8 oz, bulk.

A recall has been issued for Dye-Free Frosted Sugar Cookies because the product label failed to clearly declare the allergens Egg, Milk, and Soy due to printing quality issues. The product is packaged in a clear plastic bag, 4 oz, containing 6 cookies.
Pecan Caramel Bars are being recalled because the product label does not clearly declare the allergens egg, milk, and pecan due to printing quality issues.
Cinnamon Raisin Bagels are being recalled because the label does not clearly declare the presence of the egg allergen due to a printing quality issue.
Gluten-free brownie chocolate chip cookies are being recalled due to undeclared allergens (Egg, Milk, Soy) on the product label caused by printing quality issues.
Blueberry Bagels are being recalled because the label does not clearly declare the allergen 'Egg' due to printing quality issues. The product contains egg, which is an undeclared allergen.
A recall has been issued for gluten-free brownie chocolate chip cookies due to undeclared allergens (Egg, Milk, Soy) caused by poor printing quality on the label.

Coconut Macaroon Cookies are being recalled because the product label failed to clearly declare the allergens Egg, Milk, and Soy due to printing quality issues. The cookies are packaged in a clear plastic bag, 4 oz, with 6 cookies per package.

A recall has been issued for Gluten-free artisan white bread because its label does not clearly declare the 'Egg' allergen due to printing quality issues. The product contains egg, which is a major food allergen.
key_regulations: Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act of 2004 (FALCPA)

enrichments.summary: Artisan Seasoned Croutons are being recalled because the label fails to clearly declare the allergens Egg and Milk due to printing quality issues, posing a risk to consumers with allergies.
A recall has been issued for Artisan Cinnamon Raisin Bread due to undeclared egg allergen caused by poor printing quality on the product label.
Plain Bagels are being recalled due to undeclared egg allergen on the label, posing a risk to individuals with egg allergies.
Artisan Sourdough Bread is being recalled because its label does not clearly declare 'Egg' as an allergen, potentially endangering consumers with egg allergies.
A recall has been issued for gluten-free frosted sugar cookies due to undeclared allergens (Egg, Milk, Soy) on the product label, stemming from a printing quality issue.
Multigrain Bagels are being recalled because the product label does not clearly declare the 'Egg' allergen due to printing quality issues. The product contains egg whites and egg.
key_regulations: Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA)
